title: Mod Sandpile
description: Sandpile toppling; win when stable and **total grains mod P == R**.

title: Assembly Fetch
description: Pick up parts with ACTION5 and deliver to workstations in level order before reaching the goal.

title: Ant Trail
description: ACTION5 drops pheromone; ant steps toward strongest adjacent scent each turn; guide it to the green hole.

title: Bonus Steps
description: Low step budget; stepping on cyan bonus pads adds steps (auctioned resource feel).

title: Avalanche
description: 10×10 grid. Rocks fall one cell after each move when supported; crushed by a rock loses.

title: No Revisits
description: Reach the goal without entering any cell twice.

title: Bishop Courier
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION1–4 are diagonal slides (NW, NE, SW, SE); slide until blocked by a wall.

title: Phase Wall
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION5 arms the next move to pass through exactly one wall cell.

title: Beacon Sweep
description: 64×64 fog-of-war search. Hidden targets show as dim ghosts only inside beacon light. ACTION5 drops a beacon at the player (Chebyshev radius, limited count); ACTION6 flags a cell—must be a real target; wrong cell ends the run.

title: Manhattan Beacon
description: Beacon sweep with Manhattan (L1) reveal radius instead of Chebyshev.

title: Manhattan Beacon (variant)
description: Beacon sweep with Manhattan (L1) reveal radius instead of Chebyshev.

title: Line Flash
description: **ACTION5** toggles row vs column flash mode; **ACTION6** reveals that line and marks hidden targets hit.

title: Battery Mesh
description: ACTION5 on each tower to power it; when all towers are active, reach the goal.

title: Battery Steps
description: 10×10 grid. Charge drops each successful move; green charge pads refill to cap; 0 charge loses.

title: Crop Fallow
description: Re-entering a cell before F world steps pass loses.

title: Crate Ice
description: Sokoban where the player moves normally but pushed crates slide until blocked by wall, crate, or mud.

title: Circuit Junction
description: Wire routing with T-junction rule: no right turn relative to incoming direction on `junction` cells.

title: Circuit Junction (variant)
description: Wire routing with T-junction rule and cyan checkpoint cells: a successful test path must reach the out port through at least one checkpoint.

title: Directed Wire
description: Each orange wire sends flow one way; **ACTION6** rotates direction; connect **in**→**out**.

title: Color Gate
description: Recolor pads set active hue; doors matching the active color open.

title: Ring Tour
description: 10×10 grid. Visit every orange ring marker, then stand on the green goal.

title: Creek Crossing
description: Water blocks walking; ACTION6 places a two-cell horizontal plank; leaving a plank cell removes it.

title: Vertex Cover Click
description: Toggle cyan vertices; every edge must touch a selected vertex within the step budget.

title: Independent Cover
description: Select green cells with ACTION6; none may be orth-adjacent; every gray mark must be selected or next to a selection.

title: Multiset Cover
description: Cover **yellow** cells with **domino** (two orth clicks) or **L-tromino** (three clicks); **ACTION5** switches tool.

title: List Coloring
description: Each cell has a small **palette**; **ACTION6** cycles; orthogonal neighbors must differ.

title: Clause Toggle
description: Each clause is an **OR** of two literals (variables **v0/v1**); **ACTION6** on a literal toggles its variable; satisfy every clause.

title: Cut Gates
description: Toggle **gate** tiles until start **S** and goal **T** are no longer connected.

title: Cyclic Conveyor
description: 10×10 grid. On the conveyor row (level data), after each step you slide west while the next cell is free.

title: Row XOR Pick
description: ACTION1–4 select row 0–3; ACTION6 flips every bit in that row. Match the binary target within the step limit.

title: Routed Delivery
description: 48×48 logistics grid. Colored parcels are orders for matching customers (same color). Per-order SLA deadlines; global step budget. ACTION1–4 move; ACTION5 pickup, drop on matching customer only, or ping nearest relevant stop (target customer if carrying, else nearest parcel).

title: Heat Field
description: Temperature diffuses each step from hot/cold tiles; stand on the goal when local temp is in range; ACTION6 vents a 3×3.

title: Diffuse Only
description: No player: **ACTION5** diffuses temperature; **ACTION6** cools a **3×3**; hold probe cell in **[lo, hi]**.

title: Dig Mud
description: 10×10 grid. Gray mud blocks movement; ACTION5 digs one orth-adjacent mud tile per level budget.

title: Delay Line
description: Moves are queued (max 3). Each step executes the oldest pending move first, then appends the current ACTION1–4. ACTION5 clears the queue.

title: Domino Cover
description: ACTION6 two-click: select adjacent marked cells to place a domino covering both; cover all marks exactly once.

title: L-Tromino Cover
description: Cover every marked cell with L-trominoes using three ACTION6 picks that form an L in a 2×2.

title: Donut Wind
description: Torus wrap on a 16×16 grid; crossing the east seam increments winding — need ≥2 winding to clear the goal.

title: Dual Plane
description: ACTION5 toggles plane A/B; plane_a and plane_b walls only block on their plane.

title: Drill Rush
description: Limited wall drills plus a tight step budget to reach the goal.

title: Detour
description: Arm the cyan waypoint by stepping onto it from the required side (n/e/s/w), then reach the yellow goal.

title: Divergent Walls
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION5 toggles timeline 0/1; gray (t0) vs dark (t1) walls are collidable only on their timeline.

title: Escalator Row
description: 10×10 grid. On the escalator row (level data), after each move you auto-slide east while the next cell is free.

title: Mirror Echo
description: A mirror ghost moves with reflected horizontal delta; if the ghost hits a wall your move is blocked.

title: Hamming Target
description: ACTION6 cycles a cell through four colors; clear when Hamming distance to the target is at most D.

title: Echo Move
description: Every second step repeats the previous cardinal delta automatically.

title: Pain Budget
description: Entering a cell costs its visit count; exceed pain budget to lose.

title: Escort
description: 10×10 grid. NPC moves one greedy step toward you each turn; reach your green goal while the NPC reaches the cyan goal; collision loses.

title: Exit Hold
description: Reach the green exit pad and press ACTION5 repeatedly (hold count per level) to finish.

title: Exit Hold Sliding
description: Like exit hold, but movement only decays hold progress by 1 instead of resetting.

title: Moving Exit Hold
description: Exit hold with sliding decay; the green pad shifts every pad_period steps (pad_delta).

title: Go Up
description: Simple game - go up to reach the target.

title: Go Left
description: Simple game - go left to reach the target.

title: Go Right
description: Simple game - go right to reach the target.

title: Go Down
description: Simple game - go down to reach the target.

title: Fuse Bomb
description: Push orange bombs; fuse counts down each step; at 0 removes weak walls in radius 1 and loses if you are in the blast.

title: Follow Chain
description: Three tail sprites copy your previous positions each step; avoid overlapping them; all must reach the exit zone.

title: Ratify
description: **ACTION1–4** vote for policy slots; **ACTION5** ratifies the leader and updates three stats; clear **N** rounds without collapse.

title: Flood Fill
description: Click inside closed regions (rectangles, rings, L- and C-shaped bays) to flood-fill yellow. Wrong clicks cost steps; out of steps costs a life.

title: Flood Unpaint
description: Inverse flood fill: interiors start yellow; ACTION6 erases a clicked enclosure; gray hint cells must end unpainted. ACTION1–4 no-op.

title: Flood Unpaint (variant)
description: Inverse flood fill: interiors start yellow; ACTION6 erases a clicked enclosure; gray hint cells must end unpainted. ACTION1–4 no-op.

title: Gradient Budget Flood
description: Grow yellow from the seed orthogonally; sum of Manhattan distances from seed to painted cells must stay within budget; match gray hints.

title: Fog of War
description: 10×10 grid. Chebyshev fog radius r hides distant sprites; logic unchanged.

title: Firebreak
description: Fire spreads each step; ACTION5 places a blue break tile that blocks further spread into that cell.

title: Numberlink Lite
description: Walk the cursor; ACTION6 uses display pixels (display_to_grid) to extend or cut the path at the clicked cell between endpoints with an exact cell count.

title: Capped Path
description: Draw an orthogonal path from A to B with length at most **max_len** (Numberlink-style clicks).

title: Floor Switches
description: Activate all pressure plates (any order) to open the door, then reach the goal.

title: Floor Switches OR
description: Orange pressure plates: stepping on any one opens the door (redundant branches); then reach the green goal.

title: Floor Switches k-of-n
description: Step on required_plates distinct yellow pressure plates in any order; then the door opens; reach the green goal.

title: Wildfire
description: Fire spreads to neighbors on a timer; ACTION6 splashes water in a 3×3. Reach the green exit alive.

title: Coral Creep
description: Inert coral spreads to empty orth neighbors every M steps; coral blocks movement; reach the goal before you are boxed in.

title: Glass Floor
description: Glass tiles break on the third visit; first two visits are safe.

title: Grid Paint
description: Click cells to paint yellow; match the gray hint pattern. ACTION1–4 do nothing.

title: Grid Paint Erase
description: All floor cells start painted yellow; ACTION6 erases paint. Leave yellow only on gray hint cells.

title: Grid Paint Three-State
description: Three-state paint cycle on cells; match exact per-cell goal colors from `goal` in level data. ACTION1–4 no-op.

title: Grid Paint Blob Cap
description: Paint yellow to match gray hints; at most K connected yellow components (orthogonal). ACTION1–4 no-op.

title: Gravity
description: After each of your moves, you fall one cell downward if that cell is empty.

title: Heat Front
description: A heat band advances south every N steps; standing on a station and using ACTION5 charges temporary immunity. Reach the north goal before the heat catches you.

title: Hamiltonian Walk
description: Cover every open cell exactly once; stepping on any cell twice loses.

title: Tower of Hanoi
description: ACTION1–3 select peg A/B/C; ACTION5 picks or drops top disk (no big-on-small). Stack on right peg to win.

title: Four-Peg Hanoi
description: **ACTION1–4** select peg; **ACTION5** pick/drop top disk; stack all on the **right** peg.

title: Heatseeker
description: 10×10 grid. Hunter moves one greedy orthogonal step toward you every two player moves; reach the goal without contact.

title: Hazard Growth
description: 10×10 grid. Red hazards spread to free orthogonal neighbors every M steps; touching hazard loses.

title: Ice Slide
description: Ice floor: one arrow/WASD action slides in that direction until the next cell would be out of bounds, a wall, or a red hazard (you stop on the cell before that). Yellow goals do not block sliding—use a wall beyond the goal if the puzzle must stop exactly on the tile. Not torus wrap (see ic02).

title: Ice Torus
description: Slide until blocked; grid edges wrap (torus). Reach the goal.

title: Capped Ice Slide
description: Each move slides at most K steps in that direction (K set per level), unless blocked sooner.

title: Icing Heaters
description: **ACTION5** chills the grid; **ACTION6** toggles heaters on pads; warm every cell to **min_warm**.

title: Ink Trail
description: 10×10 grid. Each move leaves collidable ink on the cell you left; ink cannot be entered.

title: Jump Tile
description: 10×10 grid. Jump floors extend movement one extra cell in the same direction when the landing cell is clear.

title: Jigsaw Swap
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION6 on magenta trigger swaps two authored rectangles; push boxes (15) to reach the goal.

title: Key Leash
description: 10×10 grid. Yellow key must stay within Manhattan distance R of the player (leash in level data) or you lose; reach the green goal.

title: Knight Courier
description: Move with L-shaped knight steps; ACTION5 toggles between two knight-move banks (eight directions total). Reach the goal.

title: Voltage Ladder
description: Series resistor ladder from 12 V to ground: ACTION1–3 cycle each segment’s resistance; ACTION5 checks probe voltages against targets.

title: Parallel Ladders
description: Two **series** stacks (12 V top, ground bottom); **ACTION1–3** cycle **A**; **ACTION4** cycles **B**’s first resistor; **ACTION5** checks both probe pairs.

title: Laser Fence Row
description: 10×10 grid. A laser row toggles lethal/safe every P steps; avoid the row when the laser is on.

title: Lock Tumblers
description: ACTION1–3 cycle tumblers 0–5; when all match targets the door (gray wall) opens; reach goal.

title: Generations Lock
description: Conway Life on a 32×32 field. ACTION6 toggles a live cell (toggle budget). ACTION5 advances one generation. After exactly N advances, the live cells must equal the target set.

title: Torus Life
description: Conway rules on a **torus**; **ACTION6** toggles; **ACTION5** runs one generation; hit target after **N** steps.

title: Lights Out
description: Click toggles a light and its four neighbors; clear the board. ACTION1–4 do nothing.

title: Torus Lights Out
description: Lights Out on a torus: orthogonal neighbors wrap at grid edges. Walls block toggles on their cells.

title: Torus Lights Out (variant)
description: Lights Out on a torus: orthogonal neighbors wrap at grid edges. Walls block toggles on their cells.

title: Diagonal Lights Out
description: ACTION6 toggles a cell and its four diagonal neighbors only (no orthogonal toggles). Turn all lights off.

title: Knight Lights Out
description: ACTION6 toggles a cell and all cells a chess knight-move away. Clear the board.

title: Letter Path
description: Visit letter pads in authored order (A→B→C…); wrong letter loses.

title: Line Weave
description: Connect each colored start to its end with orthogonal paths; colors cannot share cells. ACTION1/2 switch color, ACTION5 undoes last segment, ACTION6 extends path to an adjacent cell.

title: Line Weave Shared
description: Like line weave but paths may share cells; entering a shared cell from a perpendicular direction to another color is forbidden.

title: Line Weave Shared (variant)
description: Like line weave but paths may share cells; entering a shared cell from a perpendicular direction to another color is forbidden.

title: Corner Cap Path
description: Connect A to B with a click-built path: length ≤ **max_len** and direction changes ≤ **corner_cap**.

title: Magnet Crates
description: 10×10 grid. After each move, metal crates slide one cell toward the player when the destination is free.

title: Tandem
description: Two players move together each step; ACTION5 swaps lead for collision resolution. Both must reach their goals.

title: Mirror Laser
description: Mirror laser: hit the yellow receptor with the beam from the orange emitter (beam starts one grid step in the emitter facing direction, usually east). Place or cycle purple mirrors with ACTION6 using display x,y (64x64, cell centers). Mirrors go on empty floor only; clicking walls, emitter, receptor, player, or off-grid wastes a step. ACTION5 fires once per step. ACTION1–4 no-op (free). Lose when the step budget (cyan HUD ticks) hits zero. Blue player tile is static and the beam passes through it.

title: Mirror Laser Dual Goal
description: Mirror laser; one beam must hit all yellow receptors in a single shot (beam passes through receptors).

title: Mirror Laser Dual Goal (variant)
description: Mirror laser; one beam must hit all yellow receptors in a single shot (beam passes through receptors).

title: Fixed Emitter Laser
description: Stepped bolt: **ACTION5** advances one cell; **ACTION6** cycles fixed mirror slots (/ → \ → empty). Optional **emit_dir** in level data (0–3) sets initial facing.

title: Memory Match
description: Classic concentration game. Flip pairs of tiles to find matches. Match all pairs to win!

title: Memory Triples
description: Flip three tiles at a time; clear a triplet when all three match color.

title: Memory Triples (variant)
description: Flip three tiles at a time; clear a triplet when all three match color.

title: Memory Peek
description: Match pairs like **mm01**; **ACTION5** once per level briefly reveals all unmatched tiles.

title: Memory Sticky
description: Like **mm01**, but tiles **orthogonally adjacent** to a matched pair cannot be flipped.

title: Momentum
description: Change direction only after at least two steps in the same direction; early turns lose.

title: Minesweeper Flags
description: Like blind sapper but ACTION6 flags suspected mines; flagging a safe empty cell loses.

title: Chord Sapper
description: Safe cells reveal mine counts in Chebyshev radius 2; flag mines with ACTION6 display clicks.

title: Edge Mine Clues
description: Digits count mines on **shared edges**; **ACTION6** flags cells — win when all mines are flagged.

title: Maze Melt
description: ACTION5 removes one adjacent wall segment until budget runs out; reach the goal.

title: Nonogram Lite
description: 10×10 board: 8×8 playfield with row/column run clues on the border. ACTION1–4 move cursor; ACTION6 cycles cell state. Wrong fills show red; win when filled cells match the hidden pattern.

title: Two-Layer Grid
description: **ACTION6** cycles the active layer’s color on a cell; off-grid click toggles **fg/bg** layer; match both targets.

title: Number Fuse
description: Collect numbered tokens in descending order; wrong pickup loses.

title: Arrow Floor
description: Landing on a magenta arrow tile forces your next move to that direction.

title: Vector Arrows
description: Arrow cells add to a pending vector; combined with your input and executed as one orthogonal step per move.

title: Sticky Vector Arrows
description: Vector arrows add to pending; pending only updates after a successful move (blocked moves keep the queue).

title: Odd One Out Tri-Cycle
description: Three bodies; ACTION5 cycles which avatar ACTION1–4 moves. Each must reach its colored pad.

title: One-Push Crate
description: Sokoban-style push, but each crate may only be pushed once per level; second push loses.

title: Orbit Keys
description: Keys orbit clockwise around a pillar each step; pick up when orthogonally adjacent.

title: XOR Hazards
description: 10×10 grid. Red and magenta hazard tiles alternate which layer is collidable after each step.

title: One-Box Push
description: Push the single crate onto the goal pad. One block, one target per level.

title: Two-Box Push
description: Two crates and two goals per level. Push both onto yellow pads.

title: Decoy Pad
description: Push the crate onto the real yellow goal. Orange decoy pad ends the run.

title: Winch Pull
description: **ACTION5** reels the nearest crate one step along the winch **direction** vector toward the winch tile.

title: Pipe Drop
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION6 cycles empty → horizontal → vertical pipe on floor; connect cyan source to yellow sink.

title: Plus Duct
description: **ACTION6** toggles a **+** junction open/closed; route flow source→sink.

title: Phase Interference
description: 24×24 phase field (0–3). ACTION6 increments; ACTION5 blurs (self + orth neighbors) mod 4 on non-walls. HUD shows target vs current phase on each target cell; blur budget ticks bottom.

title: Phase Multiply
description: Phase field: ACTION5 multiplies cell value with orthogonal neighbors modulo N (`mod_n` in data) instead of sum-blur.

title: Phase Multiply (variant)
description: Phase field: ACTION5 multiplies cell value with orthogonal neighbors modulo N (`mod_n` in data) instead of sum-blur.

title: Carry Row
description: **ACTION5** maps the row: `new[i] = (old[i] + old[i+1]) mod R` (wrap); match target.

title: Bolt Bounce
description: A red bolt moves east each step; ACTION6 toggles a mirror on an empty cell (/ vs \); guide the bolt into the yellow sink without hitting you.

title: Fixed Shooter Bolt
description: Spawn a bolt from a fixed shooter; **ACTION6** cycles mirrors; **ACTION5** advances with cooldown.

title: Polyomino Pack
description: Cover gray marks with dominoes (ACTION5 mode + two clicks) or straight trominoes (three collinear clicks).

title: Ribbon Edges
description: Two-click orth-adjacent cells to claim a marked unit edge; cover every listed edge.

title: Prime Steps
description: 10×10 grid. Cardinal moves only apply on prime step indices (2,3,5,7,…); composite steps are no-ops for movement.

title: Pattern Rotation
description: Rotate objects to match the target pattern. Click to rotate tiles 90 degrees clockwise.

title: Row Column Rotate
description: Like pattern rotation, but ACTION6 rotates an entire row or column of 3×3 tiles (nearest axis to the click).

title: Row Column Rotate (variant)
description: Like pattern rotation, but ACTION6 rotates an entire row or column of 3×3 tiles (nearest axis to the click).

title: Tile Swap
description: ACTION6 selects a cell then a second cell to swap 1×1 colors; match the board to the HUD target key.

title: Slide Row
description: Click the yellow header cell (x=0) of a row to rotate that row’s colors left; match the board to the HUD target key.

title: Pipe Twist
description: Toggle H/V pipe cells with ACTION6 so orthogonal flow connects cyan source to yellow sink.

title: Tee Pipes
description: **ACTION6** cycles each duct **H → V → T** (tee); connect cyan source to yellow sink.

title: Dual Plate Crates
description: 10×10 grid. Both yellow plates must hold a crate; then stand on the green goal.

title: Quad Twist
description: ACTION6 rotates the 2×2 block of pattern tiles anchored at the clicked cell clockwise; match the target bitmap in level data.

title: 3×3 Quad Twist
description: Rotate a 3×3 block of colored tiles clockwise with ACTION6; match the main board to the HUD target key.

title: Quantum Split
description: Step on magenta splitter; until cyan observe, moves apply to two ghost positions; observer collapses to the real one.

title: Rhythm Gate
description: Movement only applies on beat (every B world steps); other actions are no-ops.

title: Recall Once
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION5 teleports you back to the level start once per level.

title: Mirror Half
description: On the right half of the grid, left and right inputs are swapped.

title: Rotating Hazard Row
description: 10×10 grid. A lethal horizontal band advances one row every N steps; lose if you occupy that row when it advances.

title: Rook Courier
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION1–4 slide orthogonally (up/down/left/right) until blocked by a wall.

title: Rope Anchors
description: Click two orth-adjacent anchor posts (ACTION6) to place a walkable rope cell between them over water.

title: Relay Pulse
description: Place relay tiles with ACTION6; ACTION5 fires a pulse from the green source that spreads through relays. Each lamp must be orthogonally adjacent to a visited relay to light. Limited relays and fires per level.

title: Relay Pulse Depth
description: Relay pulse with hop depth limit unless passing through amplifier relays (`max_pulse_depth`, `amp_relay` sprites).

title: Relay Pulse Depth (variant)
description: Relay pulse with hop depth limit unless passing through amplifier relays (`max_pulse_depth`, `amp_relay` sprites).

title: Relay Pulse
description: **ACTION6** toggles relays; **ACTION5** floods from the source through **ON** relays; reach every lamp.

title: Ramp Rollout
description: Blue ball moves one cell per **ACTION5** with a **persistent heading**; on a **magenta ramp** tile the heading turns **clockwise** before the step. **ACTION6** toggles a ramp on a free inner cell (not wall, ball, or exit). Reach the green exit.

title: Rule Switcher
description: Collect colored targets. A signpost shows which color is currently SAFE. Wrong color = lose. After all colors have been safe, any remaining targets can be collected.

title: Rule Switcher Dual Safe
description: Collect targets matching either color of the active pair (`dual_pairs`); after all pairs cycle, any remaining target is collectible.

title: Forbidden Stripe Rules
description: Dual safe colors like rs02, plus a forbidden HUD color that is never collectible.

title: XOR Safe Targets
description: **ACTION5** toggles phase bits **A/B**; only targets matching **SAFE = palette[A xor B]** can be removed with **ACTION6**.

title: Rotating Sparks
description: Collect yellow targets while red sparks drift together in a wind direction that cycles north→east→south→west after every step.

title: Rush Grid
description: Push vertical 1×2 cars (two linked blocks) toward a clear exit lane.

title: Sand Fall
description: 10×10 grid. Sand piles fall after each move; being crushed loses.

title: Scent Stealth
description: Guards face east; high scent on a tile while in their cone line-of-sight loses. Scent decays when you leave a trail.

title: Stencil Paint
description: Move a 3×3 stencil with ACTION1–4; ACTION5 paints yellow on every non-wall cell under the stencil. Cover all gray hint cells.

title: Stencil Rotate Paint
description: **ACTION5** rotates an L-shaped 3-cell stencil; **ACTION6** paints those cells (no player move). Cover all hints.

title: Signal Lock
description: Timing bar: cursor sweeps each step; ACTION5 in the green window scores; miss shrinks the window.

title: Dual Arm Score
description: **ACTION5** alternates arms A/B and increments the active arm; reach both targets within the step budget.

title: Sokoban Push
description: Push blocks onto target pads. Green indicates a block on a target. Five levels with increasing wall blockers; grids 8×8 or 12×12 (16×16 camera).

title: Sokoban Slide Push
description: Sokoban with chain slide: after a successful push, if the cell beyond the crate is empty, the crate moves one more step.

title: Sokoban Mud Stop
description: Slide-push sokoban where the extra slide stops on mud cells.

title: Rope Pull
description: Fixed player; **ACTION6** on an adjacent crate **pulls** it one step toward you; cover pads.

title: Slide Puzzle
description: 8-puzzle: swap the hole with adjacent tiles until the board matches the goal layout.

title: Snake Collect
description: 12×12 snake: eat all yellow food, grow, avoid walls and self-collision.

title: Sandpile
description: ACTION6 adds a grain; cells with ≥4 topple to neighbors. Win when the grid is stable and total grains equals `target_sum`.

title: Sandpile Sinks
description: Like **sp01**, but grains that topple into cyan **sink** cells are removed.

title: Sequencing
description: Click colored blocks in the correct order. The sequence bar stays visible at the top. Mistakes cost 1 life; you have 3 lives per level.

title: Sequencing Reveal
description: Like sequencing, but only the current expected color block is visible; later colors stay hidden until unlocked.

title: Dual Queue Sequencing
description: Two color queues; click the block matching either head; wrong click resets both queues.

title: Sequencing LIFO
description: Click colored blocks in stack order (last in the HUD queue first). Wrong order resets progress.

title: Parity Sequence
description: FIFO order: tap the highlighted color twice in a row to lock each block; clear the full sequence.

title: Aura Algebra
description: Stepping colored zones toggles RGB bits of your aura; the exit unlocks only when aura matches (xor) the target triple.

title: Sentry Sweep
description: Avoid a guard’s forward cone; ACTION5 whistles so the guard steps one cell forward.

title: Survival: Hunger & Warmth
description: Survive by managing hunger and warmth. Green food restores hunger; orange warm zones prevent warmth decay while you stand on them.

title: Survival Shelter
description: Like survival: hunger and warmth decay; magenta shelter zones pause warmth loss only. Survive 60 steps per level.

title: Dual Shelter Survival
description: Separate warm vs food shelter zones; alternate shelter types on entry while surviving 60 steps.

title: Swap Partner
description: 10×10 grid. ACTION5 swaps you with the magenta partner when orthogonally adjacent; reach the green goal.

title: Mirror Maker
description: Mirror the pattern from the left side onto the right side. Create a perfect reflection!

title: Staggered Mirror
description: Mirror Maker with half-row mirror offset (`mirror_stagger`); place blocks on the right to match the staggered reflection.

title: Staggered Mirror (variant)
description: Mirror Maker with half-row mirror offset (`mirror_stagger`); place blocks on the right to match the staggered reflection.

title: Diagonal Mirror
description: Template dots on cells with i<j; place dots on x>y so each (j,i) matches (i,j) across y=x.

title: Bridge Builder
description: Bridge cyan water between maroon islands to the green goal. Five levels add waypoints, gray reef blocks, and optional bridge/step budgets. Toggle bridges with ACTION6; swimming costs a life.

title: Bridge Builder Decay
description: Like bridge builder, but bridges crumble when you leave the tile (set is cleared for that cell). Toggle bridges with ACTION6; swimming still costs a life.

title: Bridge Reef Growth
description: Bridge decay plus periodic random rock spawns on open water (`reef_every` / authored pool in level data).

title: Conveyor Layer
description: After each move, the player is pushed one more step by the arrow at the destination cell (`arrows` in level data).

title: Conveyor Flip
description: Packages follow arrow tiles; **ACTION5** moves all one step; **ACTION6** rotates the arrow under the click 90° CW.

title: Traffic Light
description: Crossing tile (orange) may be entered only on green phase (cycles every 4 steps).

title: Tag Evasion
description: Chaser moves every other player step; reach the safe zone or survive until the step timer ends.

title: Telekinetic Tug
description: ACTION5 pulls the nearest crate one Manhattan step toward you if the first hop is clear.

title: Twin Meters
description: 10×10 grid. Oxygen and heat decay each step; cyan and magenta pads refill; survive T steps to clear the level.

title: Teleporters
description: Walk onto paired magenta portals to warp across the map; reach the goal.

title: Directed Teleporters
description: One-way magenta portals: only the from-tile sends you to the to-tile.

title: Single-Use Teleporters
description: Portals vanish after you use a pair once; reach the goal.

title: Toxic Floor
description: 10×10 grid. Floors expire a number of world steps after first visit (ttl in level data); lose if you stand on expired tile.

title: Collection Game
description: Pre-defined collection game for ARCAGI-3 training. Checkpoint given on level completion.

title: Collection Patrol Hazards
description: Like collection, but red patrol hazards step along authored tracks each player move (`patrols` in level data).

title: Collection Spawn
description: Patrol collection; new yellow targets spawn every K steps until a cap (`spawn_every`, `target_cap` in level data).

title: Two-Touch Goal
description: 10×10 grid. Touch the orange waypoint before the green goal will advance the level.

title: Key & Door
description: Pick up the key to unlock the door and advance to the next level.

title: Two-Key Unlock
description: Two keys and two doors; stepping on a door without its matching key loses.

title: Master Key
description: Collect both silver keys to reveal the gold master key; gold opens both doors.

title: Visit All
description: Walk on every floor cell at least once. Walls are not floor.

title: Visit All Safe
description: Cover every walkable non-hazard cell; hazards block movement.

title: Ordered Waypoints
description: Visit yellow waypoints in the fixed order given by the level (first to last).

title: Infection Run
description: Plague spreads periodically; take the vaccine before walking infected cells; then reach the exit.

title: Void Path
description: 10×10 grid. Each cell allows only one visit; stepping on an already-used cell loses.

title: Vote Plates
description: Gray plate sums crate weights (1/2/4 tags); opens when sum mod M matches target; then reach goal.

title: Warp Line
description: Directed warp bands shift you +2 along their axis when the destination is clear.

title: Wall Belt
description: One row of wall segments shifts east each step (wrap); reach the goal.

title: Wind Gust
description: 10×10 grid. Every K steps an east wind pushes you one cell when free.

title: Weak Floor
description: Brown tiles collapse after you leave them; black holes are lethal.

title: Wall Craft
description: Reach the green goal on a 32×32 map. Maroon chasms are deadly gaps—bridge them with ACTION6 clicks (limited budget). Red tiles are one-touch hazards. Every action costs steps.

title: Whack-a-Mole
description: Click moles before they escape! Meet checkpoint requirements to advance.

title: Lane Moles
description: Whack-a-mole with lane spawns; clicking the wrong lane while a mole is up costs a life. Faster cadence than wm01.

title: Decoy Moles
description: Lane moles with occasional gray decoys in wrong lanes; whacking a decoy costs a life.

title: Echo Whack
description: **ACTION6** hits the mole; wrong clicks add **penalty** randomization before the next spawn.

title: Weight Plate
description: 10×10 grid. Sum orth-adjacent weight (player=1, crate=2) on the plate must reach W to unlock the goal tile.

title: World Rotation
description: Every N steps the level rotates 90° CW; ACTION5 braces to skip rotation (limited budget). Reach the goal.

title: Flood Duel
description: Two colors expand from seeds; ACTION5 switches active color; ACTION6 claims a cell adjacent to your region. Cover enough floor to win.

title: Strain Spread
description: **ACTION5** switches strain and spreads it orthogonally; **ACTION6** places a blocking cell; infect ≥ **need** of the active strain.

title: Zone Timer
description: Red hazard tiles blink on and off on a fixed timer; plan moves through safe phases.

title: Dual Phase Hazards
description: Two independent blinking hazard sets with separate period and offset.

title: Synced Dual Hazards
description: Two hazard masks share one cycle length; exactly one beat per cycle has both fields safe.
